Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Receives an additional Ki +2 per Ki Sphere obtained
*Per Super Class ally or "Future Saga" Category ally
on the team (depending on which has more members)*
- ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 150%)
- Chance of evading enemy's attack &
damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 60%)
*When there are 3 Super Class allies attacking in the
same turn, or when there is another "Future Saga"
Category ally attacking in the same turn*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When activating the Active Skill or when attacking
with 18 or more Ki*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Attacks are effective against all Types
*When receiving an attack*
- DEF 180%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Starting from the 4th turn from the start of battle*
- Meets up with Super Saiyan God SS Vegeta and
can perform Reversible Exchange
